page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 64 dedicated physical cores utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Because the system allocates exactly one thread per core, workloads benefit from fully dedicated compute resources without the performance variability associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. This resource profile is optimized for workloads that require substantial memory capacity alongside dedicated processing power.

With a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, this server is well-suited for network-intensive applications, distributed databases, and enterprise web serving. The dedicated hardware allocation offers high resource density and predictable performance, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for production environments that require stable throughput and cannot tolerate CPU scheduling delays.
